scenario: Remove an unused local function, preserve another function, refuse protected and active-transaction removal, repeat safely and compile explicitly.
limitations: Synthetic local-function removal, not widget binding or inherited/interface override cleanup.
No dedicated undo guarantee; no save/reload, open-editor callback or runtime caller-repair claim.
Ambiguous names, PIE and off-game-thread guards reviewed in source; active transaction refusal exercised.
Removing a function can leave broken callers; the tool warns but does not repair them.

confirmed_failures.finding: Live help omitted caller/binding non-repair warning because only the first sentence is exposed; wrapper stopped before native run.
Protected function removal incorrectly reported partial despite no mutation; other native checks passed.

fixes: Preflight bAllowDeletion and report unchanged before invoking stock removal.
Expose caller/binding, undo, compile/save and callback limitations in live help.
Report canonical removed function name; simplify implementation comments.
checks: Empty and missing names refuse without dirtying the package; missing result lists functions.
Active transaction and protected graph refuse without removal.
Whitespace/case-normalized removal removes requested graph and preserves other function/nodes.
Repeated removal is unchanged and clean.
Result states no caller repair or dedicated undo.
Live help exposes parameters and key limitations.
visual_review: Not applicable: function deletion has no layout or rendered output contract; graph membership and preserved node count checked in editor.
